sources.supports: Official Anthropic endpoint, explicit Flash aliases and max effort configuration. The guide also documents Claude alias mapping to Pro; this experiment used exact deepseek-flash instead.
2026-10-17 release maps the deepseek-flash API alias to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017.

configuration_note: The experiment used the exact bare deepseek-flash model ID requested by the contributor. It did not opt into the guide's optional [1m] CLI context marker or change context settings between standard trials.
attestation_limit: Provider documentation identifies the alias mapping; the API response does not independently attest a backend snapshot.
